name: Product catalogue entries

signature: id:str | bloom:enum{L1|L2|L3|L4|L5|L6} | topic:str | statement:str | options:mlist<str>[2..6]*1 | irt:tuple(a:float,b:float,c:float) | difficulty:int[1..5] | cat:tuple(area:str,exposure_cap:float,demand:enum) || feedback:str? | hint:str? | objective:str?
